remarks: PROPERTY APPRAISED FOR 1.1M WITH CURRENT CONDITION. SEE ATTACHMENT FOR APPRAISAL REPORT. Welcome to a rare East Norwalk gem on sought-after Ludlow Manor-a quiet one-way street where homes seldom become available. This spacious three-bedroom, two-full-bath home offers generously sized bedrooms, abundant living space, and a flexible layout with a bedroom and full bathroom on the main level.  The location is truly special. Walk to both Calf Pasture Beach and Shady Beach and enjoy the coastal lifestyle right outside your door. Ludlow Park and its tennis courts are directly across the street. Dog owners will love being close to the expansive and popular Taylor Farm Dog Park, featuring separate off-leash areas where dogs have plenty of room to explore and play.  The East Norwalk Metro-North station is also within walking distance, offering convenient service to New York City in approximately one hour. Restaurants, cafes, shopping, SoNo, Shorehaven Golf Club, and neighboring Westport are all just minutes away.  At home, enjoy a main-level deck, a private upper-level balcony overlooking the backyard, and the convenience of a garage. Additional improvements include a roof approximately 10 years old and a recently installed sump pump. Opportunities like this on Ludlow Manor are few and far between-come experience the space, charm, convenience, and coastal lifestyle that make this home truly special. *APPRAISAL ATTACHED*
